channel.title: M365 Roadmap Tracker — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily Microsoft 365 roadmap updates — new features, status changes, and AI summaries

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Exchange: Dynamic distribution groups now populate membership faster on creation and modification
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Dynamic distribution groups in Exchange Online will now populate membership more quickly upon creation or modification, reducing wait times significantly. This change affects Exchange Online administrators. (GA: May CY2026) — Exchange

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Authors can create interactive charts in SharePoint using AI by describing their desired chart in plain language. This feature affects SharePoint page authors. (GA: May CY2026) — SharePoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Minimized meeting window enhancements
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Teams will enhance the minimized meeting window experience, allowing users to raise hands and send reactions without restoring the full window. This affects all Teams users during meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Support for Storing S/MIME Certificates in Contacts in New Outlook
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] The new Outlook will enable users to store S/MIME encryption certificates in their Contacts, allowing for easier encrypted email communication. This change affects users of the new Outlook. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Web Link as a Reference in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot will allow users to add web links as references in Copilot Notebooks. This change affects users utilizing Copilot for note-taking. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Unified alert queue
item.description: [NEW] We’re introducing a new unified alert triage experience in Insider Risk Management that brings agent‑driven insights directly into the standard Alerts queue. With this update, analysts can view agent categorizations alongside traditional alert filters and columns in a single, consolidated workflow. (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Expanding note capabilities across alerts & cases
item.description: [NEW] We’re introducing a new collaboration capability in Insider Risk Management that enables analysts and investigators to add notes directly within alerts. With this feature, users can document investigation progress, share findings, and capture key context throughout the triage process. In addition to (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Enhanced user profile in IRM alerts
item.description: [NEW] We’re enhancing the User section within Insider Risk Management alerts to provide investigators with more contextual user profile and risk attributes directly within their workflow. With this update, analysts can now view key user details such as employee type, office location, start date, policy in (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Outlook: Variable number of message preview lines
item.description: [NEW] Outlook for Windows and Outlook for Web will now allow users to modify how the preview text for emails show in the message list. The preview text can now take up 2 lines, 1 whole line, or 0 additional lines. (GA: June CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [NEW] Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
item.description: [NEW] The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes. Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place. Users can read, (GA: August CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for MCP Agents with Interactive UI Widgets in Government Clouds
item.description: [NEW] Feature description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat. This enhancement enables developers to deliver more engaging and structured agent interactions. Users will experience these widg (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): MCP-Based Agent Enablement for U.S. Government Clouds
item.description: [NEW] We’re introducing support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot . This update enables developers to build Copilot agents using MCP servers and allows users to interact with these agents using familiar experiences. This change supports extensibility and improves agent (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Declarative agents with Actions available in GCC High and DoD
item.description: [NEW] Declarative Agents with Actions enable Microsoft 365 Copilot to take real-world actions by invoking APIs, plugins, and enterprise workflows directly within the chat experience. Using custom actions, declarative agents can call external systems, execute operations, and retrieve or update data, moving (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [NEW] Endpoint Data Loss Prevention — Endpoint DLP now supports a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition
item.description: [NEW] Endpoint DLP now includes a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition. Previously, file extensions were entered as free form text, which could result in unsupported or non-scannable extensions being used. This could lead to gaps in protection and increase processing overhe (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App
item.description: [NEW] The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over ea (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
item.description: [NEW] We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [NEW] Planner: My Tasks redesign
item.description: [NEW] A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused. Copilot helps surface your top priorities. (GA: June CY2026) — Planner

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dataverse data connected to Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: [NEW] Let people search and query Dataverse business data from Microsoft 365 Copilot. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Preloaded video for Teams Events and Meetings
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Report external users for security concerns in Teams
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams now enables users to report suspicious external users directly, with reports visible in the Teams admin center for admin follow-up. This change impacts all Teams users and admins. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Built‑in AI Interpreter for Calls on Teams Phone Devices
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Teams Phone Devices will now include an AI Interpreter feature that provides real-time language interpretation during calls. This change affects users participating in multilingual conversations. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Shortcuts for Pages on Mobile
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Mobile users will gain access to Copilot Shortcuts for suggested prompts to edit Pages, enhancing mobile productivity. This change affects mobile users of Microsoft 365. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 app: Add Search results as references to your Copilot Notebooks in the M365 Copilot app
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] The Microsoft 365 app will allow users to add search results as references in Copilot Notebooks. This change impacts users utilizing the Copilot app for documentation. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app

item.title: [UPDATED] Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing OCR support
item.description: [UPDATED] Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations (DSI) is extending our investigations by adding optical character recognition (OCR), extracting text from images and incorporating it into investigation data. This enables AI-powered deep content analysis to uncover data security risks that are often hi (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Teammates Calendars in Left Nav in calendar
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook will now display colleagues' and direct reports' calendars by default in the left navigation. This change impacts users of the new Outlook for Windows. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Account Switching for Native Mac Controls via Dock and Menu Bar
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams will introduce account switching controls for Mac users, simplifying navigation between accounts and tenants. This change affects Teams users on Mac. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Simplified Teams app bar to create a cleaner and more focused experience.
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams is simplifying its app bar for a cleaner experience, making it easier to navigate apps. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Teams Phone Device user multi-line
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Teams Phone will allow administrators to assign up to 10 phone numbers to a single user, enabling seamless calling from multiple numbers. This feature benefits users managing diverse roles or regions. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Customers can connect M365 Copilot with 15Five to surface team priorities and recognition with Copilot Connector
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Customers can connect M365 Copilot with 15Five to highlight team priorities and recognition. This change impacts users of 15Five within Microsoft 365. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Unified attachment flow on Teams Mobile
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Teams Mobile introduces a unified attachment flow, allowing users to easily attach files or media from various sources. This affects all Teams mobile users. (GA: June CY2025) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Now smarter with visuals: Declarative Agents leverage embedded images for richer, more accurate answers
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Declarative Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot can now use embedded images from documents to provide richer, more accurate answers. This change affects users relying on Copilot for complex queries. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft 365: Department Billing for Microsoft 365 Backup
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Department Billing for Microsoft 365 Backup allows admins to configure backups by departments or locations and manage costs. This affects backup management. (GA: March CY2025) — Microsoft 365

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Sharing recap access
item.description: In Microsoft Teams, recording and transcript owners can grant access to specific people for recap links without requests. This change affects users who share recordings and transcripts. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (iPhone)
item.description: OneNote will introduce multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks, allowing users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in one session. This feature benefits users capturing diverse content. (GA: May CY2026) — OneNote, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chose Anthropic models when editing with Copilot in Word
item.description: In Word, users can now choose Anthropic models alongside OpenAI models when using Copilot for editing. This change affects users of Microsoft 365 who utilize Copilot in Word. (GA: May CY2026) — Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: External Domains Anomalies Report
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce an External Domains Anomalies Report to help admins identify unusual interactions with external organizations. This feature is designed for IT admins to monitor security risks. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage private content in M365 Copilot
item.description: M365 Copilot will now use content from private communities and events, ensuring users can only access information they are authorized to see. This affects users utilizing M365 Copilot. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Start writing, coding, and creating with Copilot in Pages
item.description: Microsoft Copilot will enable users to co-create content or code in Pages using the tools menu. This affects users working with Copilot in document creation. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Mind Maps in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Mind Maps will be added to Copilot Notebooks, providing interactive visualizations of key topics and relationships. This feature is aimed at enhancing user understanding of notebook content. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), OneNote

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Ability to create cases without content in IRM
item.description: Insider Risk Management in Microsoft Purview will allow the creation of cases without content, increasing the active case limit to 2000. This change affects administrators managing insider risk cases. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Surveys Agent and Copilot Chat in Microsoft Forms
item.description: Microsoft Forms now includes Copilot Chat and the Surveys Agent, which assists users in improving forms and analyzing results. This feature is available to users with a Copilot license. (GA: May CY2026) — Forms, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Lists in Context IQ
item.description: Users can now search for and select SharePoint Lists through the Context IQ menu in Copilot Chat. This change affects users utilizing Copilot Chat. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Excel spreadsheets from Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Microsoft Copilot allows users to create Excel spreadsheets from content in Copilot Notebooks, streamlining the process of turning ideas into spreadsheets. This affects users who utilize Copilot Notebooks. (GA: May CY2026) — OneNote, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable customers to book appointments from a live chat widget on your website
item.description: The Teams live chat widget now allows customers to schedule appointments directly from a business's website. This change affects businesses using the chat widget. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: SharePoint: Chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents in Teams
item.description: Users can now chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents directly within Teams chat, enhancing support and communication. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), SharePoint

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Efficiency Mode
item.description: Teams will have an efficiency mode that reduces resource usage on low-performance devices, improving meeting quality. This change affects all Teams users on constrained hardware. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app on Teams mobile
item.description: The Queues app will be available on Teams mobile, enabling call representatives to manage call queues and customer interactions on the go. This change affects mobile Teams users handling calls. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Device Health Reporting Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Purview will introduce a Device Health Reporting Dashboard for admins to monitor device health and readiness for policy updates. This change impacts IT administrators. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Submit agent to Agent Store from Agent Builder
item.description: Admins can now review and approve custom Copilot agents submitted to the Agent Store, allowing organizations to share validated agents. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Book future meetings directly from Teams panels
item.description: Teams panels now allow users to book future meetings directly by selecting available time slots from the calendar. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Device licenses. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Jump to Any Folder Instantly with Go to Folder
item.description: Outlook introduces a Go to Folder feature that enables users to quickly search and navigate to any mailbox folder by typing part of the folder name. This change affects Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Test your microphone before you join
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to test their microphone and speakers before joining a meeting. This feature helps ensure audio clarity for participants. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Identify bots joining your Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers to see and control external bots trying to join meetings, enhancing meeting security for organizers. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Instantly Find Rules, Quick Steps, and More by Name
item.description: Outlook introduces a name search feature for managing email automation tools like Rules and Quick Steps, making it easier to find items. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced issue detection in Teams Rooms on Windows and auto-remediation with Teams Rooms Pro Management.
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows will improve issue detection and auto-remediation for meeting spaces. This change benefits IT admins by reducing troubleshooting efforts and ensuring room readiness. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Room health signals and notifications in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows will display notifications for critical issues affecting room functionality, helping users resolve problems quickly. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts
item.description: Microsoft Teams will now preserve @mentions and shared contacts when copying and pasting messages, improving the accuracy of pasted content. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Onboarding emails for Leaders
item.description: Microsoft Viva will send automated onboarding emails to Leaders to promote the use of the Copilot Dashboard in Viva Insights. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved organization for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will automatically organize muted and meeting chats into dedicated sections, helping users manage their conversations better. This affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced media quality for Direct Guest Join
item.description: You’ll notice media quality improvements including support for up to 16 participant videos (4×4 grid) available in May and simulcast streaming (June) when using Direct Guest Join. These updates make cross‑platform meetings more immersive and reliable when joining Teams meetings from Zoom, Google Mee (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Brand Impersonation Protection for Teams Calling
item.description: Teams calling will now include brand impersonation protection to identify potential phishing attempts from external users. This feature impacts enterprise users receiving calls via Teams. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
item.description: Meeting organizers in Microsoft Teams can now delete generated content like recordings and transcripts from the recap page using a new delete button. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks
item.description: Microsoft Teams will have improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks, making it easier for users to collaborate on code. This change affects all Teams users working with code blocks. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: New and Improved People Hub on Web
item.description: Outlook Web will feature a new People Hub with a modern interface, improved search, and automatic linking of duplicate contacts. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Miracast support for Teams Rooms on Windows devices
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows devices will support Miracast for wireless sharing, in addition to existing HDMI options. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Action Segments
item.description: The Microsoft 365 admin center now allows IT admins to target Organizational Messages using dynamic, pre-defined usage segments. This change enhances message targeting for admins. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Email messages
item.description: Organizational Messages in the Microsoft 365 admin center now supports Email as a delivery channel, expanding communication options for admins. This affects how messages are delivered to users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Add Breakout Room Participants in Bulk Using CSV
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow bulk assignment of breakout room participants using a CSV file, streamlining the setup process for organizers. This feature is relevant for Teams meeting organizers. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Endpoint DLP support classification of Azure RMS protected Office documents
item.description: Endpoint DLP will classify Azure RMS protected Office documents on Windows devices, triggered by file usage or just-in-time classification. This impacts IT administrators. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Update Health
item.description: Cloud Update will provide enhanced error reporting for Microsoft 365 Apps updates, offering clearer error messages for failed updates. This feature helps admins diagnose issues more efficiently. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app

item.title: Microsoft Edge: Copilot New Tab Page
item.description: The new Copilot New Tab Page in Microsoft Edge will allow users to search, chat, and access curated content more efficiently. This change impacts all Edge users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Edge

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Catch up on conversations in Microsoft Teams mobile
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile will provide a unified view of conversations, allowing users to easily catch up on chats and threads, impacting mobile users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Copilot provides coaching feedback in chat as you draft, edit and format emails
item.description: Outlook will now feature Copilot providing coaching feedback on email drafts, allowing users to apply suggestions directly. This change impacts all Outlook users drafting emails. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
item.description: Outlook will enable users to draft, edit, and format emails conversationally with Copilot, enhancing email composition. This change affects Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: SharePoint: New SharePoint Experience
item.description: SharePoint is introducing a new experience focused on knowledge discovery and content publishing, with an updated design. This affects all SharePoint users. (GA: May CY2026) — SharePoint

item.title: Outlook: Import emails from PST file to mailbox in new Outlook for Windows
item.description: Users can import emails from PST files into their mailbox in the new Outlook for Windows. This feature will assist users migrating from older Outlook versions. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Badging updates help find messages that count in the chat list
item.description: Microsoft Teams will now display badges on the app bar to indicate activity in chats and channels, making it easier to find unread messages. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
item.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing a new Data Security Posture Management experience to enhance data security and AI integration. This affects organizations using Purview. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-stream IntelliFrame support for GCC-H and DoD in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: GCC-H and DoD customers can use multi-stream IntelliFrame in Teams Rooms on Windows for improved visibility in hybrid meetings. This change affects Teams Rooms users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi‑camera view support for GCC-H and DoD in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: GCC-H and DoD customers can now switch between multiple camera feeds in Teams Rooms on Windows for better engagement. This change affects Teams Rooms users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items from unread-only view
item.description: Teams will allow users to filter chat and channel lists to show only unread items, with an eye icon to access read items without leaving the view. This feature impacts all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Honor Windows Do not disturb setting
item.description: Microsoft Teams will now respect the Windows Do Not Disturb setting, pausing notifications when enabled. This affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
item.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce a branded footer that displays the organization’s logo and an 'Approved by' label. This change affects administrators managing branding settings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting participants can request collaborative annotation sessions
item.description: In Microsoft Teams meetings, participants can request to start collaborative annotation sessions, which require approval from the presenter. Organizers can control who can start annotations through a new Meeting Options setting. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Account Selector in Outlook Copilot Side Pane
item.description: Outlook adds an account selector in the Copilot side pane for users with multiple accounts, simplifying account management. This change affects users with multiple Copilot-enabled accounts. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Annotations on Teams Single Window Sharing on macOS
item.description: Teams on macOS will allow presenters to share a single application window and enable participant annotations, enhancing privacy and engagement during presentations. This affects Teams users on macOS. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Consecutive interpretation in Interpreter
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce consecutive interpretation, allowing turn-based interpretation during meetings for better interaction across languages. This change affects all Teams users participating in multilingual meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Branded Meeting Reactions
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizations to upload custom branded meeting reactions for participants. This change affects meeting experiences by enhancing brand visibility during meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Triage your inbox on-the-go with Copilot voice for Outlook mobile
item.description: The Outlook mobile app will feature a Copilot voice experience to help users manage their inbox by summarizing unread emails and allowing actions like flagging or archiving. This change affects users of the Outlook mobile app. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: One-time email passcodes for external presenters in Teams events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will implement one-time email passcodes for verifying external presenters, impacting event organizers and tenant administrators. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM data risk assessments: item-level investigation & remediation
item.description: Microsoft Purview will allow item-level investigation and remediation of SharePoint data, helping users manage overshared items with new insights. This affects SharePoint users and compliance teams. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Private channels increased limits and transition to group compliance
item.description: Private channels in Teams will transition to using a shared mailbox, increasing member limits and applying compliance policies. This affects Teams administrators and users managing private channels. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Planner: Task chat and mentions in basic plans
item.description: Planner will introduce task chat and mentions in basic plans, enabling team members to collaborate directly on tasks. This change affects users who manage tasks within Planner. (GA: January CY2026) — Planner

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Backup RTMP Support for Teams town halls
item.description: Teams town halls will support a backup RTMP stream to maintain live broadcasts during interruptions. This change affects users hosting town hall events in Teams. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Entra: Cross-tenant security group synchronization
item.description: Microsoft Entra introduces cross-tenant security group synchronization, allowing organizations to manage security groups across tenants. This affects IT admins managing multiple tenants. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Entra

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – AI analysis enhancements
item.description: Data Security Investigations in Microsoft Purview enhances AI analysis tools for faster categorization and data preparation. This change affects security teams conducting investigations. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Content Explorer – Enhanced Tag (SIT, Labels) Filter at UI Layer
item.description: Microsoft Purview's Content Explorer now has enhanced filtering controls for SIT and label data. This improves content discoverability and governance for admins. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview
